title: Manufacturer Copay Assistance and the Pharmacy Benefit Plan Accumulators
content:
Plan sponsor program description: how manufacturer copay assistance is treated in the deductible and out-of-pocket accumulators of the Pharmacy Benefit Plan.

## Program terms

1. **At adjudication.** The claim's full member cost share posts to the deductible and out-of-pocket with the funding source member-paid, whoever later pays it.
2. **When manufacturer assistance pays part of the cost share,** the design's copay-assistance program decides what happens next:
   - **Standard:** nothing further posts, so the assisted amount keeps counting.
   - **Accumulator adjustment:** the assisted amount is backed out by reversal postings with the funding source manufacturer-assistance, under the same source record. The part of the assistance that paid the deductible portion comes off the deductible, and the whole assisted amount comes off out-of-pocket.
3. **Limits of a back-out.** A back-out never exceeds what the claim posted, and it is the only kind of reversal that leaves the claim itself standing.
4. **HSA-qualified designs.** Because HSA-qualified designs must charge the member the deductible from the member's own funds, every design in the HSA-qualified high-deductible family runs accumulator adjustment.

## Program by program

| | Standard | Accumulator adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| Posting at adjudication | Full member cost share, member-paid | Full member cost share, member-paid |
| After manufacturer assistance pays part | Nothing further posts | Assisted amount backed out, manufacturer-assistance funding, same source record |
| Effect on the deductible | Assisted amount keeps counting | Assistance that paid the deductible portion comes off |
| Effect on out-of-pocket | Assisted amount keeps counting | The whole assisted amount comes off |
| The claim itself | Stands | Stands |

## Worked examples (hypothetical claims)

**Claim wholly within the deductible.** A claim's member cost share is 180.00, all of it deductible portion; 180.00 posts to the deductible and 180.00 to out-of-pocket, member-paid. Manufacturer assistance then pays 120.00 of it.
- Under standard, nothing further posts: 180.00 stays counted on each accumulator.
- Under accumulator adjustment, 120.00 comes off the deductible and 120.00 comes off out-of-pocket, as manufacturer-assistance reversals of the same claim; 60.00 remains counted on each.

**Claim after the deductible is met.** A copay of 60.00 posts to out-of-pocket, member-paid, with no deductible portion. Manufacturer assistance pays the whole 60.00. Under accumulator adjustment, 60.00 comes off out-of-pocket and nothing comes off the deductible; under standard, nothing further posts.
